newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Itau upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Itau upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities said it raised its rating on Brazilian private bank Banco Itau to buy from market performer.
-- "We are upgrading Banco Itau ... in light of the bank's current depressed valuation and expectation of a 32 percent price appreciation by December 1997," Caspian said in a report.
-- Itau's price has been stagnant and has underperformed the local market by 27 percent since early May, it said.
-- Itau is one of Brazil's largest private banks.
-- Itau's expected 17 percent annual earnings growth for the 1997-98 period is not fully reflected in its current valuation, Caspian said.
-- The bank will post strong earnings by raising credit volumes to make up for a drop in net interest margin, it said.

-- Despite lower systemic risk due to the Banespa state debt deal and upcoming solution to problems at Bamerindus , Caspian said it remains worried about asset quality deterioration and the timing of interest rate declines.

-- The bank's strengths are large capital structure and "enviable" net interest margin, while its weaknesses are asset quality deterioration, increased foreign competition, and poor revenue diversification, it said.
-- "We believe asset quality should stabilize by mid-1997 following a gradual decline in interest rates," it added.
-- Itau preferred was off 13 reais at 387 reais while its common was flat at 375 reais at 1405 local/1105 EST on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
